user.description: Choose the LED panel to add, or enter its address by hand.

manual.description: Enter the panel's Bluetooth address (for example AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF). You find it in Settings - Bluetooth - Advertisement monitor.

abort.already_configured: This panel is already set up.

error.invalid_address: That is not a valid Bluetooth address (format AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF).

show_text.name: Show text
show_text.description: Show centred text on the panel. Use a new line for more lines (up to 5 at scale 1).

text.name: Text
text.description: Text to show. New lines start a new row.

line_colors.name: Line colours
line_colors.description: Optional colour per line, for example [[255,160,0],[0,200,255]].

scale.name: Size
scale.description: 1 = small (8 characters per line), 2 = large (4 per line).

panel.name: Panel
panel.description: Panel name or address. Only needed with more than one panel.

fill.name: Fill colour
fill.description: Fill the whole panel with one colour.

panel.name: Panel
panel.description: Panel name or address. Only needed with more than one panel.

show_image.name: Show image
show_image.description: Show a picture file (PNG, JPG, GIF first frame) scaled to the panel.

path.name: File
path.description: Path to the picture, for example /config/www/panel/ghost.png.

fit.name: Fit
fit.description: contain = whole picture, cover = fill and crop, stretch = distort to fit.

panel.name: Panel
panel.description: Panel name or address. Only needed with more than one panel.

panel.name: Panel
panel.description: Panel name or address. Only needed with more than one panel.

show_icon.name: Show picture
show_icon.description: Show a built-in 32x32 picture: a weather state (use the state of a weather entity), moon (today's phase), season (today's season) or autumn/winter/spring/summer. Rain, snow and falling leaves can be animated.

icon.name: Picture
icon.description: Weather state (sunny, rainy, ...), moon, season, autumn, winter, spring, summer, smog or heating.

caption.name: Caption
caption.description: Short text under the picture, e.g. 12°C. Moon shows its phase name when left empty.

duration.name: Show for
duration.description: Seconds to keep the picture (the action waits this long). Rain, snow and falling leaves move meanwhile. 0 = just send it.

panel.name: Panel
panel.description: Panel name or address. Only needed with more than one panel.

frame_interval.name: Frame interval
frame_interval.description: Seconds between animation frames. The panel needs time to show each frame; too fast makes it lag behind. 0 = still picture.

language.name: Language
language.description: Language of automatic captions (moon phase, charging): en or pl. Default: Home Assistant's language.

night.name: Night version
night.description: Moon and stars instead of the sun (sunny, partly cloudy, summer). Default: automatic, after sunset (sun.sun).

show_clock.name: Show clock
show_clock.description: Clock face: large HH:MM, two small lines below and an optional level bar (e.g. PM2.5).

time.name: Time
time.description: Text for the big digits, e.g. 17:36. Default: current time.

bar_value.name: Bar value
bar_value.description: Value for the bar at the bottom (green to red). Empty = no bar.

bar_max.name: Bar maximum
bar_max.description: Value that fills the whole bar (default 75).

panel.name: Panel
panel.description: Panel name or address. Only needed with more than one panel.

style.name: Style
style.description: classic = large digits; flip = split-flap cards like an old flip clock.

animate.name: Animate flip
animate.description: Flip style: play the card flip when the time changes.

tint.name: Tint
tint.description: Show the whole clock in one colour, e.g. red at night. Empty = normal colours.

transition.name: Transition
transition.description: slide = the new screen pushes a different one out to the left (e.g. clock after readings).

date_text.name: Date line
date_text.description: 64x16 panels: the clock moves up and this line goes under it, e.g. PON 9.11.

show_nearest_aircraft.name: Show nearest aircraft
show_nearest_aircraft.description: Read ADS-B data (aircraft.json from readsb, dump1090 or tar1090) and show the closest plane: silhouette in its direction of flight, callsign/type, altitude and distance. Returns the plane's data; nothing is shown if no plane is in range.

max_distance.name: Maximum distance
max_distance.description: Ignore planes further away than this (km).

latitude.name: Latitude
latitude.description: Your position. Default: the home location in Home Assistant.

longitude.name: Longitude
longitude.description: Your position. Default: the home location in Home Assistant.

panel.name: Panel
panel.description: Panel name or address. Only needed with more than one panel.

frame_interval.name: Frame interval
frame_interval.description: Seconds between animation frames. The panel needs time to show each frame; too fast makes it lag behind. 0 = still picture.

count.name: Planes
count.description: 64x16 panels: the nearest planes in turn, each sliding in.

show_aurora.name: Show aurora forecast
show_aurora.description: NOAA geomagnetic (Kp) forecast for the next 24 hours, plus the OVATION aurora probability at your location now (nowcast_local) and just north of it (nowcast_horizon). Draws only when the Kp peak reaches the minimum.

url.name: Forecast URL
url.description: NOAA SWPC Kp forecast JSON (default is fine).

min_kp.name: Minimum Kp
min_kp.description: Only show the picture if the forecast peak reaches this Kp (0 = always).

tint.name: Tint
tint.description: Show in one colour, e.g. red at night.

panel.name: Panel
panel.description: Panel name or address. Only needed with more than one panel.

show.name: Show on panel
show.description: Off = only return the forecast (for sensors and automations), draw nothing.

nowcast_url.name: Nowcast URL
nowcast_url.description: NOAA OVATION aurora nowcast JSON (default is fine).

latitude.name: Latitude
latitude.description: Your position for the nowcast. Default: the home location.

longitude.name: Longitude
longitude.description: Your position for the nowcast. Default: the home location.

show_readings.name: Show readings
show_readings.description: Up to four readings with small icons, coloured by level (temperature, humidity, PM2.5, PM10, pressure, in that order). Unavailable values show as --.

pm25.name: PM2.5
pm25.description: µg/m³; green, yellow, orange, red with the air quality.

tint.name: Tint
tint.description: Show in one colour, e.g. red at night.

panel.name: Panel
panel.description: Name or Bluetooth address; only needed with several panels.

transition.name: Transition
transition.description: slide = the new screen pushes a different one out to the left (e.g. clock after readings).

show_retro.name: Show retro screen
show_retro.description: 64x16 panels: a retro screen or little animation: atari (blue 8-bit start-up screen), c64 (purple one), invaders (marching aliens), terminal (a root prompt running rm -rf /*), chomper (a green monster munching gems in a maze, a bat behind), runner (an adventurer leaping a gap), agent (an agent fighting a drone); random = any of them.

screen.name: Screen
screen.description: One of the screens above, or random.

text.name: Text
text.description: atari and c64: the scrolling line; invaders: a caption, e.g. DING DONG!

tint.name: Tint
tint.description: Show in one colour, e.g. red at night.

panel.name: Panel
panel.description: Name or Bluetooth address; only needed with several panels.

show_room.name: Show room
show_room.description: 64x16 panels: a steaming pot, the room name, its temperature (blue cool, green comfortable, orange warm) and humidity, or the set point of a radiator valve.

tint.name: Tint
tint.description: Show in one colour, e.g. red at night.

panel.name: Panel
panel.description: Name or Bluetooth address; only needed with several panels.

target.name: Set point
target.description: Shown as →20° when there is no humidity, e.g. a radiator valve's target.

show_sky_graph.name: Show sky graph
show_sky_graph.description: 64x16 panels: 24 hours of temperature, the last hours from history and the hourly forecast; day warm with a sun, night blue with stars, now as a blinking line.

weather.name: Weather
weather.description: Weather entity with an hourly forecast.

history.name: History sensor
history.description: Temperature sensor for the hours before now (needs the recorder).

hours_back.name: Hours back
hours_back.description: How much of the past to show.

tint.name: Tint
tint.description: Show in one colour, e.g. red at night.

panel.name: Panel
panel.description: Name or Bluetooth address; only needed with several panels.

show_traffic.name: Show network traffic
show_traffic.description: 64x16 panels: download (up) and upload (down) of the last minutes from history, with the current rates and packets running along the middle.

download.name: Download sensor
download.description: Data-rate sensor (bit/s, kbit/s, Mbit/s, B/s, kB/s, MB/s ...).

max_rate.name: Top of the graph
max_rate.description: Mbit/s; empty = the highest value shown.

tint.name: Tint
tint.description: Show in one colour, e.g. red at night.

panel.name: Panel
panel.description: Name or Bluetooth address; only needed with several panels.

show_forecast.name: Show forecast
show_forecast.description: Weather in a few hours and tomorrow: picture, hour or weekday, temperature (side by side on 64x16, stacked on 32x32).

weather.name: Weather
weather.description: Weather entity with hourly and daily forecasts.

hours_ahead.name: Hours ahead
hours_ahead.description: The first point: this many hours from now.

language.name: Language
language.description: Weekday names: en or pl (default: Home Assistant's language).

tint.name: Tint
tint.description: Show in one colour, e.g. red at night.

panel.name: Panel
panel.description: Name or Bluetooth address; only needed with several panels.

play_animation.name: Play animation (stored)
play_animation.description: Stores an animation in one of the panel's slots as a GIF; the panel then plays it by itself, smoothly, also while disconnected, until the next picture. A built-in animation (64x16) or your own GIF file.

screen.name: Built-in animation
screen.description: atari, c64, invaders, terminal, chomper, runner or agent (64x16 panels).

file.name: GIF file
file.description: Your own GIF (in an allowed folder, e.g. /config/www); scaled to the panel.

frames.name: Frames
frames.description: How many frames to store (built-in animations, or the first frames of a file).

frame_ms.name: Frame time
frame_ms.description: Milliseconds per frame (built-in animations; a file keeps its own timing).

slot.name: Slot
slot.description: The panel's storage slot; an unchanged animation is not uploaded again.

text.name: Text
text.description: atari and c64: the scrolling line; invaders: a caption.

panel.name: Panel
panel.description: Name or Bluetooth address; only needed with several panels.

set_playlist.name: Set playlist
set_playlist.description: Which stored slots the panel plays in turn; also what it shows while nothing is connected.

slots.name: Slots
slots.description: A list of slot numbers, e.g. [1] or [1, 2].

panel.name: Panel
panel.description: Name or Bluetooth address; only needed with several panels.

set_brightness.name: Set panel brightness
set_brightness.description: The panel's own brightness, 0-100 %. Unlike the brightness of a picture it keeps the pixels' full colour, so dim screens stay readable.

panel.name: Panel
panel.description: Name or Bluetooth address; only needed with several panels.
